feedback: can you make it more obvious that its a lava theme and make the ship more lava themed

selection.reason: Making the environment and the player ship more lava-themed can be achieved purely through visual changes in the renderGame function, such as using warmer color palettes (reds, oranges, yellows) and altering the drawing shapes to look more like lava/fire.

patch.notes: Updated background colors and crust layers to feel more intensely lava-like. Redesigned the player ship as an obsidian vessel with glowing lava cores. Added inner bright spots to enemies and fireballs to make them pop more as magma entities.
